features.feature: V1 user-visible milestone_status report over existing ProofStory facts: JSON/text visibility with completed/current/remaining grouping, active sub-objectives, evidence refs, risks, next actions, and read-only mode flags.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 through CHK-004 userSees and verificationIntent cover schema, grouped text, missing-ledger behavior, evidence detail, no-mutation behavior, docs, and tests; plan.md Scope and CHK plans define the report model, CLI command, row projection, and grouped workflow; original_intent_snapshot_get acceptanceClaim binds the same V1 read-only report outcome.

features.feature: Truthful missing-ledger, missing-detail, partial-progress, and stale-or-missing evidence behavior in milestone rows.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 edge requires a missing-ledger blocker and next action; CHK-003 edge/adversarial require partial rows and stale or missing evidence not reported as DONE; plan.md CHK-001 and CHK-003 require unavailable transition detail to be reported rather than invented and done-like status without evidence to produce warning/next action; decision_get principle and preMortem require missing evidence or ledger detail to be explicit.

features.feature: ProofStory intent artifact coverage for the read-only milestone_status V1 scope.
features.covered_by: original_intent_snapshot_get records the normalized outcome and acceptance claim; milestone_ledger_get confirms M1-M4 with checklistRefs and all 12 verificationIntentRefs; intent_collision_get accepts the read-only interpretation and rejects executor/phase/reviewer/completion-writer meanings; proofstory_contract_get has diagnosticGaps empty and binds the confirmed ledger hash; intent_coverage_check and proofstory_gate_check both pass with no gaps.
features.source: original_intent_snapshot_get; milestone_ledger_get; intent_collision_get; proofstory_contract_get; intent_coverage_check; proofstory_gate_check

features.feature: Lifecycle mutation, execution authority, reviewer launch, evidence writing, automatic DONE, Authority completion, production readiness, and lifecycle-gate replacement.
features.excluded_by: scope-boundary excluded list; plan.md Scope; CHK-001/CHK-002/CHK-004 adversarial verificationIntent; decision_get rejected full automatic lifecycle pipeline; intent_collision_get acceptedInterpretation excludes automatic executor, phase advancement, reviewer launcher, and separate milestone completion writer; lifecycle readiness and story lifecycle docs keep read-only reports separate from lifecycle gates and Authority/production claims.
features.source: scope-boundary.json; plan.md; checklist_get; decision_get; intent_collision_get; lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md; story-lifecycle.md

features.feature: New milestone storage system or second milestone execution ledger.

scope_contract_show protectedFiles and explicitExcludes include README.md; explicitExcludes also include .omx/**; understanding_get constraints say not to modify the existing dirty README.md change from main and not to use OMX or .omx; current git status before save showed no code or README changes.
